name: arrival-notice
title: Arrival notice
for_each: select id,reference from shipments where direction='import' and delivered_on is null and status not in ('draft','closed','cancelled')

sections.title: Shipment
sections.note: Check the vessel and ETA with the carrier before you send this.
sections.sql: select s.reference,s.house_bill,c.name as consignee,k.name as carrier,s.voyage,s.origin_port as from_port,s.destination_port as to_port,coalesce(s.ata,s.eta) as arrival,s.goods,s.packages,s.weight_kg,s.volume_m3 from shipments s join parties c on c.id=s.customer_id left join parties k on k.id=s.carrier_id where s.id=$1

sections.title: Containers and free time
sections.note: Free time runs from the vessel's arrival. Detention applies from the day after it ends until the empty is back.
sections.sql: select t.number,t.size,t.seal,coalesce(t.free_days,(select default_free_days from organisation)) as free_days from containers t where t.shipment_id=$1 order by t.number

sections.title: Charges to collect
sections.sql: select code,description,amount,currency from charges where shipment_id=$1 and side='revenue' order by code

name: job-sheet
title: Job sheet
for_each: select id,reference from shipments where status not in ('draft','cancelled')

sections.title: Charges
sections.sql: select x.side,x.code,x.description,p.name as party,x.amount,x.currency,x.fx_rate,x.status,x.invoice_ref from charges x join parties p on p.id=x.party_id where x.shipment_id=$1 order by x.side desc,x.code

sections.title: Milestones
sections.sql: select code,planned_on,actual_on,note from milestones where shipment_id=$1 order by coalesce(actual_on,planned_on)

name: customer-statement
title: Open shipments
for_each: select distinct c.id,c.name from parties c join shipments s on s.customer_id=c.id where s.status not in ('draft','closed','cancelled')

sections.title: Where your shipments are
sections.sql: select s.reference,s.house_bill,s.origin_port || ' > ' || s.destination_port as route,s.voyage,s.etd,s.eta,s.ata,s.status from shipments s where s.customer_id=$1 and s.status not in ('draft','closed','cancelled') order by coalesce(s.eta,s.etd)

sections.title: Invoiced and to come
sections.sql: select s.reference,x.code,x.description,x.amount,x.currency,case when x.status='invoiced' then x.invoice_ref else 'to be invoiced' end as invoice from charges x join shipments s on s.id=x.shipment_id where s.customer_id=$1 and x.side='revenue' and s.status not in ('draft','closed','cancelled') order by s.reference,x.code
